newsitem.title: MALAWI: Malawi T-bill rate falls at fortnightly tender.
newsitem.headline: Malawi T-bill rate falls at fortnightly tender.

text.p: The average discount rate for Malawi's three-month Treasury bills fell to 15.53 percent at the latest fortnightly tender from 18.33 percent two weeks ago, the Reserve Bank said on Tuesday.
Applications for the 177 million kwacha of bills on offer totalled 175 million. The average price was 96.7589 percent.
The average rate for six-month bills was 16.96 percent, down from 18.35 percent. Applications for the 158 million kwacha of bills on offer totalled 82 million. The average price was 92.5205 percent.
